question.worked_solution:
q-139689: Let's examine our diagram. - There is $1$ arrow starting at Station A and ending at Station B. So, there is only one route from $A$ to $B,$ and so $a=1.$ - There is $1$ arrow starting at Station B and ending at Station B. So, there is only one route from $B$ to $B,$ and so $b=1.$ - There are no arrows starting at Station C and ending at Station A. So, there are no routes from $C$ to $A,$ and so $c=0.$ As a result, our route matrix is the following:
To:
A B C
From: A $1$ $1$ $0$
B $0$ $1$ $2$
C $0$ $1$ $0$
Therefore, $$ a+b+c=1+1+0=2. $$
